_comment: Hand-labeled ground truth for the Gate 1 text-region-detector fixture (reports/2026-07-05-glyph-read-design.md section 5, Gate 1). Frames are 240x160 GBA screenshots drawn from runs/probe_*/world/ (6 recorded GBA sweep-probe games, HANDOFF 2026-07-04) plus a handful of pure no-text distractor frames from the same sweep. One entry per frame; 'targets' is a list of ground-truth text-bearing bboxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] in source-frame pixels (loose boxes around each visually distinct text block/row-group, drawn by inspecting the PNGs directly at 3x with a pixel ruler overlay -- not derived from any detector's own output). Distractor frames (pure scenery/logo-art/blank with no legible glyphs) have an empty 'targets' list and must score 0 phantom candidates for Gate 1 to pass.
